scenario.zh:
刚开始交往。
后来你发现，对方家庭经济条件比较普通。
你最可能会怎么想？
scenario.en:
You've recently started dating someone.
Later you learn that their family has fairly modest financial circumstances.
What would you most likely think?

text.zh: 我们可能不太适合，我会重新考虑这段关系。
text.en: I may rethink whether we're the right match.

interpretation.zh: 家庭条件对你来说，可能进入了是否继续的判断里。
interpretation.en: Family circumstances may enter your decision about whether to continue.

options.immediate: 用户把家庭经济背景纳入关系匹配的筛选。

text.zh: 我更看重的是这个人，家庭条件不是决定因素。
text.en: I care more about the person than their family background.

interpretation.zh: 你可能把人本身放在结构条件前面。
interpretation.en: You may put the person ahead of the structural conditions around them.

options.immediate: 用户以内在的人本身为锚，淡化家庭结构条件。

text.zh: 顺其自然吧，走到哪一步再看。
text.en: I'll just let the relationship develop naturally and see where it goes.

interpretation.zh: 你可能不急着把这一点变成结论——先让关系自己走。
interpretation.en: You may not rush this into a conclusion — let the relationship move first.

options.immediate: 用户对未定事项放松，暂不做基于背景的判断。

text.zh: 我相信未来可以一起努力，把生活过好。
text.en: I believe we can build a good future together through our own efforts.

interpretation.zh: 起点对你来说可能不决定终点——努力还能改写。
interpretation.en: The starting point may not decide the ending for you — effort can still rewrite it.

options.immediate: 用户以共同努力归因未来，淡化起点结构。

text.zh: 我会先继续了解，不急着因为这一点做决定。
text.en: I'd keep getting to know them before making any judgement.

interpretation.zh: 你可能把判断留到了解更多之后——这一点还不够下定论。
interpretation.en: You may hold judgment until you know more — this alone is not enough to decide.

options.immediate: 用户克制过早判断，继续加深了解。
